decision_rule: every common and candidate-specific gate must be PASS with current hash-bound evidence; no quorum degradation, weighted score or fallback is allowed

common_mandatory_gates.requirement: both witnesses authenticate the exact same closed checkpoint bytes
witness identity, auth, recovery, host and evidence roots differ and neither controls the audit store
caller nonce is atomically single-use and issue/expiry is bounded to ten minutes
epoch, sequence and previous checkpoint advance atomically in a rollback-resistant store
same-sequence alternate heads and divergent descendants quarantine the chain
rotation requires independent recovery authorization, higher epoch, continuous predecessor and old-root revocation
bounded parsers, dependencies, licenses and advisories are independently reviewed
loss of a witness or high-water state blocks acceptance rather than reducing quorum

dual_dsse_offline_witnesses.requirement: two signatures verify under distinct active consumer-selected roots
both envelopes use exact payload type, canonical signature shape and PAE over checkpoint bytes
witness signing keys are unavailable to audit store, build jobs and the other witness
each witness has a distinct offline recovery root and rehearsed epoch advance

dual_webauthn_human_witnesses.requirement: two independently witnessed roaming-authenticator enrollments have distinct credential/recovery roots
both assertions require exact allowlisted RP ID and origin with no fallback
both require ES256, UP, UV, non-backup flags and exact checkpoint challenge
loss, replacement and collusion procedures preserve two independent human domains without emergency quorum reduction
